What each backend states on constant time, as the capability table read it:

* `botan`: Botan 3.14.1: doc/api_ref/kdf.rst states no constant-time property of its KDFs, and their source (src/lib/kdf/) none.
* `openssl`: OpenSSL 3.5.9: doc/man7/EVP_KDF-X963.pod states no constant-time property.

`x963kdf` has no default backend: the call names one of its backends, as its second template argument (<<hash-default-backend>>).
